flag_rule: Consistency level 2 (consistido) is measured and level 1 (raw) provisional; day status 2 (estimated) is estimated at either level.
notes: ANA computes daily flow from the gauge's daily level with a rating curve (curva-chave) fitted to field flow measurements; the service's method field MetodoObtencaoVazoes is 1 on 376 of 377 month rows (other codes: {'2': 1}). We read code 1 as the rating curve, but ANA's code list was not found, so that reading is not confirmed (ANA HidroSerieHistorica).

Where a month exists at consistency level 2 (consistido, reviewed by ANA) we use it; otherwise level 1 (raw), marked provisional. Last level-2 day: 2023-12-31. Level-1 days used: 882. Days present at both levels, level 2 kept: 0 (ANA HidroSerieHistorica).
Per-day status codes on the days kept: {'1': 11052, '2': 340, 'blank': 60}. Status 2 (estimated) is marked estimated; status 3 (doubtful) is kept with its consistency-level quality (ANA).
Days with a value but status 0 or blank: 60; kept with their consistency-level quality (ANA).
Missing days are blank in ANA's rows and are not in this file; no fill values found (ANA).
